title: All to Jesus
lyrics_original: All to Him I freely give;
I will ever love and trust Him,
I surrender all, I surrender all,
All to Thee, my blessèd Savior,
Humbly at His feet I bow,
Take me, Jesus, take me now    || I surrender all ||
Let me feel the Holy Spirit,
Truly know that Thou art mine.     || I surrender all ||
Lord, I give myself to Thee;
Fill me with Thy love and power;
Let Thy blessing fall on me.     || I surrender all ||

bible_verses.telugu: కాబట్టి సహోదరులారా, పరిశుద్ధమును దేవునికి అనుకూలమునైన సజీవ యాగముగా మీ శరీరములను ఆయనకు సమర్పించుకొనుడని దేవుని వాత్సల్యమునుబట్టి మిమ్మును బతిమాలుకొనుచున్నాను. ఇట్టి సేవ మీకు యుక్త మైనది.
bible_verses.english: Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, in view of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God—this is your true and proper worship.

bible_verses.telugu: మరియు ఆయన అందరితో ఇట్లనెను        ఎవడైనను నన్ను వెంబడింప గోరినయెడల తన్నుతాను ఉపేక్షించుకొని, ప్రతిదినము తన సిలువను ఎత్తికొని          నన్ను వెంబడింపవలెను.
bible_verses.english: Then he said to them all: 'Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross daily and follow me.'

bible_verses.telugu: నేను క్రీస్తుతోకూడ  సిలువ వేయబడియున్నాను;  ఇకను జీవించువాడను నేను కాను, క్రీస్తే నాయందు జీవించుచున్నాడు. నే నిప్పుడు శరీర మందు జీవించుచున్న జీవితము నన్ను ప్రేమించి, నా కొరకు తన్నుతాను అప్పగించుకొనిన దేవుని కుమారునియందలి విశ్వాసమువలన జీవించుచున్నాను.
bible_verses.english: I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I now live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I come before You today with open hands and a humble heart. I surrender my fears, my ambitions, and my desire for control into Your gracious care. Help me to daily choose Your presence over the fleeting distractions of this world. Teach me to trust You completely, knowing that in releasing my life to You, I truly find it. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, I come before You today with open hands and a humble heart. I surrender my fears, my ambitions, and my desire for control into Your gracious care. Help me to daily choose Your presence over the fleeting distractions of this world. Teach me to trust You completely, knowing that in releasing my life to You, I truly find it. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: True freedom is found not in holding tightly to our own lives, but in placing everything into the loving hands of Jesus. When we sing of surrender, we are simply responding to the One who first gave His all for us on the cross. Releasing our control, our plans, and our worldly ambitions isn't a loss—it is the open-handed posture through which we receive His abundant life. Today, take a gentle step toward Him, trusting that whatever you surrender to Christ is held in perfect love.
